name: @kiwa-test/quality-metrics
description: Quality metrics harness for kiwa v0.5 — 13-axis release gate + historical trend tracking + drift detection。 v0.1 baseline → v0.2 mutation gate → v0.3 tier-aware → v0.4 release-gate context → v0.5 で historical trend tracking + drift detection 追加。 MetricSnapshot + BaselineComparison + DriftDetection + TrendReport SSOT + captureSnapshot + compareToBaseline + detectDrift + generateTrendReport export。 shape 契約 preserving = 既存 QualityReport 構造無変更、 additive のみ、 backward compat 絶対維持 (v0.1-v0.4 API 変更 0)。 depth-5 pattern 3 例目確定 (Mobile v1.54-v1.55 + Desktop v1.60-v1.61 + quality-metrics v1.65 で 3 例安定化到達、 「絶対的 rule」 昇格 signal)。

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
